data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on 18 tons each this month? That gives each of us $18,000 and leaves 10 tons, avoiding collapse. Next month’s stock would be 100 tons with 75% probability or 20 tons otherwise—not a guaranteed refill. For future months, I propose we divide the stock above a 10-ton reserve equally, rounding each catch down to whole tons. We can review catches together each month. This only works if everyone sticks to the limits; grabbing extra now puts all our future income at risk. John, would you agree?
